changes.description: Normalize manual campaign replay bounds and the cached bar index to UTC so replays spanning daylight-saving-time offset changes render correctly; make final family and stop classifications reflect the already-frozen sufficient-sample results without changing any trading result.

test_changes.description: Add a regression test for UTC-normalized replay slicing across a daylight-saving-time boundary.
Add regression tests for sufficient-sample family abandonment and stop-comparison reporting classifications.
